source_relationship: Separate NBS releases, not independent institutional corroboration. Main release and detailed retail, investment and property pages were opened and read; original HTML was additionally retrieved.
pitfalls: GDP and industrial value added growth are real; GDP monetary level is current-price.
Investment comparable statistical basis does not mean constant prices.
Retail sales do not cover all household services consumption.
Fixed-asset investment is not the national-accounts capital-formation measure.
Second-hand housing transactions are not developer presale funding.
Do not use obsolete 4.4% forecast as actual or suggest a beat versus a verified consensus.
Industry growth rates are not GDP contribution rates.

copyright.terms_read_via: Search returned full page text after direct-open timeouts.
terms_findings: NBS asserts copyright in site contents by default.
Section 3 explicitly permits downloading and using NBS statistical data, subject to law and accurate use.
News/informational public-free reasonable quotations require prominent attribution to NBS and website.
Site-specific graphics, logos, layout and other excluded content are not covered by general welcome-to-reproduce wording.
copyright.law_findings: Article 5 excludes specified governmental legal/administrative/judicial instruments, simple factual news, and common tables/formulas. Article 15 can protect original selection/arrangement of data. Do not equate every government-authored article or photograph with public domain.
copyright.publication_basis: Use factual numerical statistics permitted by NBS data-use terms; independently selected arrangement and original economic analysis. No full official prose, release structure, or original image reproduced.
copyright.ordinary_copyright_text_budget: Methods explanations limited to brief independently worded factual definitions; no direct quotations. Across all five editions preserve source 2, 5 and 7 summaries within 200 words per source. Numerical-data reuse is documented separately under explicit NBS data-use permission; do not extrapolate permission to photographs or graphs.
